0:
api: yes
apiAddress: :9997
authInternalUsers:
  - user: any
    permissions:
      - action: publish
      - action: read
      - action: playback
      - action: api
rtsp: yes
rtspAddress: :8554
rtmp: yes
rtmpAddress: :1935
hls: yes
hlsAddress: :8888
hlsVariant: fmp4
hlsSegmentCount: 3
hlsSegmentDuration: 1s
webrtc: no
srt: no
paths:
  all_others:
mkdir -p /data/db /data/files /data/thumbs /data/staging /data/backups && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --no-access-log --proxy-headers
app lidarr_log radarr_log sonarr_log prowlarr_log postgres template0 template1

server:
  port: 80
  sources:
    - path: /media
      config:
        defaultEnabled: true
auth:
  methods:
    noauth: true
